rows.assumption: A free tier drives top-of-funnel growth
Free users convert to paid at a meaningful rate
All our competitors have a free tier, so we need one
Adding a free tier has no opportunity cost
The current ICP (B2B teams, ~$10K/year contracts) responds to free-tier self-service
Free-tier acquisition cost is lower than current outbound acquisition cost
A free tier will not cannibalise existing paid accounts or renewals

chains.title: The competitor-parity argument cannot justify adding a free tier
The free-tier decision is empirical, not a convention to follow; a time-boxed pilot is the minimum required action before any adoption decision
The pilot threshold for adoption must be pre-specified before the pilot begins, not inferred from results afterward

conclusion.recommended: (chains C2 and C3) Run a time-boxed 90-day pilot with a limited cohort of free-tier users (up to 5 users, limited projects) to generate the conversion data currently absent in GT-4?. Exclude existing customer domains and prospects in active deals from the pilot cohort, so the pilot cannot cannibalise paid accounts or renewals. Before the pilot launches, pre-specify the break-even threshold *formul

dead_ends: Competitors have free tiers, therefore we need one
